text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the spring Tenno Sho has arrived, and Super Creek is getting wound up by Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross even threatens to whomp me so badly that I'll never recover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to protect me, Super Creek takes on the race against Tamamo Cross with her heart ablaze.
